title: Tyler Loop: Nothing's changed for me, I'm still confident in my abilities

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Tyler Loop: Nothing's changed for me, I'm still confident in my abilities
sources.description: Ravens kicker Tyler Loop had a chance to send his team to the playoffs in Week 18, but he missed a field goal at the final whistle in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers that set off an offseason of change in Baltimore that included the departure of head coach John Harbaugh.
